DAEMON.description: Path to the SGE execution daemon binary.

PIDFILE.description: Path to the PID file for the execution daemon.

SCRIPTNAME.description: Path to the init script file.

DAEMON_ARGS.description: Additional arguments passed to the daemon at startup (typically empty in default config).

SGE_START_EXECD.description: Whether to start the Grid Engine execution daemon (must be 'yes' to allow start). Enum: ['yes', 'no']

VERBOSE.description: Whether to enable verbose logging (non-empty, non-'no' enables logging). Enum: ['yes', 'no']
